info.title: Loam console API
info.summary: The control API behind the Loam console: org, teams, projects, environments, agents, keys and audit.
info.description: Design: docs/design/19-console-identity-and-agents.md. The data API (collections, documents, query) is the native API under /v1 and is not part of this contract. Timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC. Lists are wrapped in an object keyed by the plural resource name.

servers.description: The native REST listener (the console is served at /ui)

tags.name: session
tags.description: The install, first-run setup and console sessions.

tags.name: org
tags.description: The organization: its settings, members and invitations.

tags.name: teams
tags.description: Groups of members that receive project roles.

tags.name: projects
tags.description: Projects and who can access them.

tags.name: environments
tags.description: An environment is one engine namespace, with a name and usage.

tags.name: agents
tags.description: AI agents: policies, trust policies for federation, and their short-lived tokens.

tags.name: service-accounts
tags.description: Non-agent workloads such as CI jobs.

tags.name: api-keys
tags.description: Long-lived keys for SDKs and service accounts; never for agents.

tags.name: audit
tags.description: Every mutating call and token issue, with the actor and whom it acted for.

tags.name: oauth
tags.description: Token exchange, user delegation and the documents MCP clients discover.

Error.description: The engine's error body: a stable code and a human message.

setup_required.description: True until first-run setup has created the org and its owner.

Instance.description: What this install is and how people sign in. Public: the console reads it before sign-in.

namespace.description: The engine namespace this environment is (1:1).

protected.description: Destructive actions need the project admin role.

PolicyRule.description: What a principal may do in one environment; collections null means all.

Agent.description: An AI agent: a principal that only ever holds short-lived tokens (design §19 §5).

subject.description: The federated subject (for example repo:acme/search:ref:refs/heads/main), or the delegating user's id.

subject_pattern.description: Glob over the federated token's sub claim.

TrustPolicy.description: Which external workload identities may exchange their token for this agent's.

prefix.description: loam_<key_id>, safe to show; the secret is never returned again.

action.description: Dotted, for example agent.token.issued or collection.dropped.

ProtectedResourceMetadata.description: RFC 9728. A 401 from a protected route carries WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="<this document's URL>".

ConsentDecision.description: The signed-in user's answer on the consent screen, carrying the authorize request's parameters.

redirect_to.description: The client's redirect_uri with code and state, or with error=access_denied.

session.name: loam_session
session.description: Console sessions; mutating requests also send X-CSRF-Token.
